upheld.title: Order number link on My orders has no styling
upheld.detail: The new <a> around the order number is not covered by any style: Orders.razor.css has no rule for .order-number a and app.css has no general link style. It renders as a blue, underlined browser-default link that does not match the bold ink-coloured number column or any other link on the site.
upheld.requirement: ORDD-1 Outputs: 'each order number is a link to that order's details page'; Project context: new UI must match the existing pages and design system

upheld.title: Missing-order video never shows the requested number 999999
upheld.detail: Video 06 shows 'Order not found' with the caption 'Order not found (HTTP 404)', but no frame or caption names the order number that was requested, so you can't tell from the video that it is the 999999 case.

upheld.title: Coverage gap
upheld.detail: The style coverage table marks '.editorconfig via dotnet format --verify-no-changes' as unverifiable: the command was not run, and the judge could not run it either. No finding covered it. Nothing in the diff looks misformatted.

dismissed.title: Order summary has no heading
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. The story's Outputs require only that the number, date, status and total are shown, and they are (OrderDetails.razor:19-42). A summary heading is a preference.

dismissed.title: Back-link arrow icon has no alt attribute
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. role="presentation" already removes the decorative arrow from the accessibility tree, and the back link has its text label 'Back to my orders'.
